# Pill Land

Pill Land has moved. The official Pill Land site is https://vedrino.website/pill-land

Pill Land is Dynamic Island for Windows, a Windows 10 and 11 productivity app by Minimal Studio Lab, and phase one of Project Vedrino (https://vedrino.website). It is coming soon to the Microsoft Store.

## Still on this site

- Privacy policy: https://alokxyz1112.github.io/pillland-site/privacy/
- Support: https://alokxyz1112.github.io/pillland-site/support/
